title: Burden dokkal ngal jaɓaaka
intro: E nder fajiri daartol aadee, nde leydi ndii ina famɗi, aduna oo ina joginoo fooftere mum adannde, ruuhu ina darii yeeso Tagɗo oo ina jogii sadakeeji lesɗi. Ndeen sadak teskaama e nder njuuteendi jaɓgol Alla — tawa ina ŋakki. Ko rewi heen koo wonaa daartol yaafuya, kono ko ɓernde ɓuuɓnde, nde ardi e golle ɗe mbaylaaka, ɗe njiylotoo ko e sahaa kala. Ko ɗum woni daartol gooto mo innde mum wonti ko nanndi e tooñannge mawnge gadane ɗe meeɗaa waɗde.
clues: Mi arii e nguurndam ko gooto e sukaaɓe adanɓe jibinaaɓe, jibinaaɓe e jibinannde nde nganndu-ɗaa daartol mum no feewi.
Mi meeɗii sakkitde Alla sadak, kono ɗum jaɓaaka e am — hay so tawii sadak banndi am jaɓaama e moƴƴere.
Haayre e tikkere njippii e ɓernde am, miɗo hulɓinii ngam joofnude nguurndam banndiraaɓe am.
Sibbo am jeertinii kam yo mi hul Alla, kono mawnikinaare am jaɓaani mi heɗaade.
E nder dumunna tampere kulɓiniinde, mi waɗii golle ɗe kaalaaka e dow miñi am.
Caggal mum, mi anndaa hay no suucfirmi ko mbacfmi koo — haa tagoore leydi neldaa ngam jannginde mi.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Qabil (Kayin)
Habil (Haabil)
Ɓiɗɗo Annabi Nuuhu
Annabi Ismaa'il
Annabi Yuusuf

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Sakkude sadak mo jaɓaaka, addani warngo adanngo
Mahde suudu toowndu ngam yettaade asamaan
Wereede e nder yiite ɓuuɓɗo ngam goonɗinal mum
Sakkaade ɓiyum e dow ɗooftaade Alla
Muusde liɗɗi mawɗi ngam dogde e golle mum
trial.answer: Sakkude sadak mo jaɓaaka, addani warngo adanngo

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Kuɗol ngol Alla neli ngam hollitde wirwirnde
Ilam mawɗam ɓuuɓɗam leñol fof
Sawru wayliima wonti mboddi guurndi
Gelooɗi debbo ummoriiɗo e tufnde kaaƴe
Jappeere mawnde nde henndu mawndu nawtata
location.answer: Kuɗol ngol Alla neli ngam hollitde wirwirnde

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Wonti e tuumiiɓe, tedduɓe e bonannde adannde nde meeɗaa waɗde
Ko Alla yaafaama, rokkaama Aljanna duumotooɗo
Ummiima e darnde toownde annabaagal e hakkille
Hisnaama e yurmeende Alla caggal nde noddi e nder luggiɗnde niɓɓere
Hokkaama laamu dow jinneeji, henndu, e maayo
outcome.answer: Wonti e tuumiiɓe, tedduɓe e bonannde adannde nde meeɗaa waɗde

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
